messages:
alex_cs: TigerBay day0 check-in — quick sync on networking / IAM / KMS / audit logs. small list of things we saw in preflight, want owners and ETA.

maria_se: thanks alex. list please, I'll triage and add to customer board.

alex_cs: TL;DR: 1) egress whitelists missing 3 internal Splunk endpoints 2) KMS key policy needs cross-account grant for their infra account 3) service role for Redwood -> TigerBay S3 buckets not created 4) audit logs forwarding rule dropped on last dryrun 5) renewal signal: they asked about 15% discount if we can guarantee 99.95 for Dedicated in Q4.

sam_infra: on the whitelist — can you paste the IPs/hostnames? I can open a network ticket and poke infra team.

alex_cs: hostnames: splunk-logs.tigerbay-prod.internal, splunk-collector-02.tigerbay, splunk-s3-forwarder.tigerbay. CIDRs they use in their firewall: 10.12.0.0/22 and 198.51.100.0/24.

sam_infra: got it. I'll add to ticket INFRA-7821 and request egress rule by EOD PST. assigning to @sam_infra.

leah_eng: KMS cross-account: what principal do they need? we typically grant role arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:role/RedwoodCrossAccountRole with kms:Decrypt kms:GenerateDataKey.

alex_cs: correct. TigerBay expects a principal in their infra account arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/tigerbay-service-role. they want the policy to include kms:DescribeKey as well.

leah_eng: noted. I'll prepare the key policy snippet and paste here for them to include in their side.

leah_eng: ```
{
  "Sid": "AllowTigerBayAccountUsage",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/tigerbay-service-role"},
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey","kms:DescribeKey"],
  "Resource": "*"
}
```

maria_se: for the service role/S3 access — do they have a bucket name yet? we need a trust policy from their side or we'll create a role in their account.

alex_cs: they want Redwood to assume a role in our account for uploads: `arn:aws:iam::555666777888:role/redwood-s3-uploader`. we need to confirm our bucket policy allows that ARN.

sam_infra: I will validate bucket policy. if missing, I'll add a conditional allowing `s3:PutObject` from that role and lock down prefix `logs/tigerbay/`.

alex_cs: audit logs: their ops noticed the forwarding rule to splunk-s3-forwarder failed on last dryrun — looks like a Lambda timed out. logs show 504 on function `rbw-audit-forwarder-prod`.

leah_eng: can you paste the snippet of the timeout logs?

alex_cs: ```
[2026-03-22T14:03:11Z] ERROR Runtime.TimeoutError: Lambda handler timed out after 30.00s
    at Runtime.module.exports.handler (/var/task/index.js:45:12)
```

leah_eng: 30s is our default. quick fix: bump to 90s and add retry; long-term we should optimize the S3 PUT path. I'll put a PR for the Lambda config.

maria_se: owners recap: sam -> egress + bucket policy check, leah -> KMS policy + lambda timeout PR, alex -> coordinate with TigerBay for role ARNs and discount ask. ETA for network + bucket policy?

sam_infra: network by EOD PST today. bucket policy check + change, if needed, by tomorrow noon PST.

leah_eng: KMS policy ready in 2 hours, lambda PR today.

alex_cs: I will confirm role ARNs with TigerBay now. also flagged renewal ask as a risk on the account page (renewal_risk: moderate) and noted the 15% discount request. prep note: sales should not commit discount until we sign off on SLOs.

maria_se: added risk flag and created ticket CS-4489 with action items + owners. I'll loop in sales ops to get guidance on discount posture.

opsbot: IncidentBot: New ticket created CS-4489 by maria_se — TigerBay day0 cutover items (network/KMS/S3/audit). Priority: P2.

alex_cs: small follow-ups: 1) can infra whitelist 198.51.100.0/24 for Splunk collector? 2) confirm whether TigerBay will rotate the KMS key within 30 days (they said yes but need documented plan).

sam_infra: whitelisting confirmed. 198.51.100.0/24 open.

alex_cs: perfect. last ask: can someone draft the short runbook snippet I can send to TigerBay ops for the cutover window (30min checklist)?

leah_eng: I'll draft a 5-step runbook and drop here in 30m.

maria_se: thanks team — will update customer board and ping TigerBay for role ARNs and rotation RFC.

alex_cs: :thumbsup: closing loop for now. will post any blockers as replies here.
